messages:
Anika: Noticed a checksum drift in nightly snapshots for tenant-77 during the restore smoke test. manifest sha256 != object sha256 :warning:
Mike: Which snapshot and where was it pulled from?
Anika: s3://backups-prod/snapshots/tenant77/2026-03-25/tenant77-2026-03-25.tar.gz. Manifest lists sha256=9f12...e4c, downloaded file hashes to 7b55...2d1. Sizes and gzip header look normal.
Sara: Any lifecycle or re-encrypt jobs touching that prefix recently?
Anika: Lifecycle job ran 2026-03-26 03:02 UTC. head-object shows x-amz-meta-sha256=9f12...e4c but content differs.
Javier: That points to a CopyObject or reupload that replaced bytes but preserved metadata, or alternately metadata was copied and later object replaced without metadata update. Check S3 versioning and CopyObject logs.
Mike: ops-bot, open ticket ENCOPS-4402 and pause lifecycle for that prefix.
ops-bot: ENCOPS-4402 created: snapshot-integrity-failure for tenant-77. Lifecycle paused for s3://backups-prod/snapshots/tenant77/ (by Mike).
Anika: Found previous version v-0f9e3 that matches manifest. Current head is a newer version that doesn't. Downloaded both for diff.
Javier: I'll grep encryptor-daemon logs for CopyObject calls and review the recent deploy diff. Suspect a metadata overwrite path where MetadataDirective=REPLACE with an empty map was used during CMK rotation.
Sara: I'll query CloudTrail for CopyObject events and kms:GenerateDataKey operations in the 48h window. Command: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=CopyObject --start-time 2026-03-24 --end-time 2026-03-27`
Mike: Remediation plan: (1) restore authoritative version (use CopyObject with MetadataDirective=COPY), (2) add unit test to encryptor-daemon to ensure x-amz-meta-sha256 is preserved, (3) add post-copy checksum verification and alert on mismatch.
Anika: Restored prior version using CopyObject+MetadataDirective=COPY and validated sha256 matches manifest. Kicking smoke test now.
ops-bot: ENCOPS-4402 updated: restored prior version and smoke test queued (by Anika).
Mike: Good. Javier, please prepare a patch for encryptor-daemon to avoid overwriting metadata and include a canary. Sara, add CloudTrail evidence to the ticket. We'll keep lifecycle paused until fix is deployed. :thumbsup:
